peer_shape: LibreDWG issue #1410; peer report used as a test-shape lead, not a reproduced libdxfrw defect
scope: Generated local DXF import -> DWG write -> DWG readback for one AC1024 and one AC1032 profile
implementation: Added --issue-1410-cross-codec to the existing libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip executable and registered one fast CTest.
Generated temporary ASCII DXFs at runtime; no DWG/DXF fixtures were added.
AC1024 checks an explicit-zero HATCH line-edge Y, hash-bearing ATTRIB/ATTDEF tags and prompt, attributed INSERT/SEQEND structure, and following LINE continuity.
AC1032 checks multiline embedded MTEXT on ATTRIB and ATTDEF, including group-46 defined height and scoped background flags, scale, ACI/truecolor/name/transparency values.
DXF parsing now derives R2018 embedded host attribute type from the host subclass: 2 for ATTRIB and 4 for ATTDEF.
DWG embedded-MTEXT CMC parsing and encoding now retain true color and optional color/book names through bounded read and separate string-stream write paths.
True-color CMC readback reports ACI index 256 while retaining RGB/name/transparency; the test records this codec projection rather than asserting redundant DXF group equality.

specification_review.source: Open Design Alliance, Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.46 MTEXT
specification_review.relevant_fields: Background flags, conditional scale, background CMC, transparency, and R2018 additions

evidence_boundary.claim: Local codec round-trip evidence for the generated AC1024 and AC1032 entity profiles only
